pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Hermes Agent is a terminal AI agent by Nous Research that writes and refines its own skills from experience, schedules jobs, and can be reached through messaging gateways. It drives any OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.
The wrappers in /usr/bin disable runtime pip installs and the automatic download of the tirith command scanner; extras that are not packaged report themselves unavailable instead.
